Che diritti mi dà?: What rights does it give me?
Dichiarazione di ospitalità o contratto: Hospitality declaration or rental contract or residence certificate
Dura un anno. Alla scadenza, può essere: It lasts one year. When it expires, it can be renewed or converted into a residence permit for work reasons.
Non è obbligatoria una denuncia penale m: A criminal complaint is not mandatory, but you must help clarify the facts and identify those responsible.
Occorre il parere positivo della Procura: A positive opinion from the Public Prosecutor's Office or the Labor Inspectorate is needed.
Prima di tutto devi palare con un consul: First of all, you must talk to a legal advisor about your work situation.
Questo permesso viene dato a chi lavora: This permit is given to people who work in seriously unjust conditions because someone takes advantage of their need (“labor exploitation”).
mancanza di regole su salute e sicurezza: lack of health and safety rules
